fragments.text: Shares of Common Stock, $0.001 Par Value Per Share
Company common stock, par value $0.001 per share (“Company Stock”), that
connection with and as a result of the consummation of the Merger, shares of Company Stock ceased to trade on the Nasdaq Stock Market
